name: @hobo/secret-store-claim
description: The secrets.config-service/v1 capability, chosen when a HoBo deployment runs and handed to its owner by claim: offers routed by HoBo policy (auth.md stores, a Cloudflare temporary account, self-hosted Infisical, an existing Infisical Cloud organization), provisioning against each, and a HoBo claim bundle whose one-time actions carry the claim links (ADR-0179 amendment).
